metadata.title: Capgo Native Build data | Builder trends
metadata.description: Global native iOS and Android build success, processing time, and failure mix for the last 30 days. Rates and minutes only, not queue counts and not realtime.

blocks.text: Global iOS and Android builder success for the last 30 days. Each rate is finished jobs only, not a live queue, and not a build count.
Success and failure over the last 30 days. The sparkline is one tick per UTC day, green at 70% or better.
Hourly or daily iOS and Android rates, plus average processing time, depending on the selected window. Use 1D, 1W, 1M, or 3M to change the chart range. This chart is not a live feed.
